answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost reduction. With the primary contract expiring in 14 days and zero production buffer, switching vendors (memory_c2) or adding a second source (memory_c3) introduces unacceptable delivery risk. Deferring (memory_c5) risks a supply gap. Renewing without change cannot meet the cost target. Negotiating terms with the incumbent leverages the proven stability of the relationship (memory_c1), has a track record of recovering margin through benchmarking (memory_c4), and can unlock volume pricing via multi-year commitments (memory_c6), achieving the cost objective without increasing supply chain risk.
